note: The two known wrapper cases. This node has no create_publisher and no create_subscription call at all, yet it publishes /diagnostics and subscribes to two point cloud topics. Without the wrapper table these three endpoints show up as observed only and read as drift. The /diagnostics topic name is stated by diagnostic_updater and not by this source, so it is marked wrapper_constant. line_hint is advisory and never compared.
